NETWORK_ERROR.description: Temporary network issue. Retry the payment once.

INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.description: Customer may need another payment method. Generate a payment link.

CARD_EXPIRED.description: The customer's card has expired. Ask the customer to update their payment method.

BANK_DECLINED.description: The bank declined the transaction. Provide an alternative payment method.

SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY.description: Potentially suspicious transaction. Do not retry automatically. Send for human review.
